author: THSV StreamBridge
description: The first real person to chat on each platform each stream gets a spot on a small on-stream card, with an all-time times-first count.
changelog: 4.1.69: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.69, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.1.20: new Chat First extension with one first-chatter spot per platform per stream, podium, row and column layouts, an all-time times-first count and an optional chat message.

manifest.name: Chat First
installationSteps: Tick the platforms where the first chatter gets a spot.
Pick the card layout and whether it stays on screen all stream or shows for a few seconds.
Add the overlay as a browser source (1920x1080) in the scenes where the card should show.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source.

healthChecks.description: Confirms first-chat detection per platform, the stream reset, the times-first count and the card overlay.
